name: 16063 · Zelienople, PA
findings: ZIP 16063 (Zelienople) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (63%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16063 (Zelienople) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
